c74object.name: mc.evi.bands~
c74object.digest: Evenly distribute resonant filter bands across a spectrum
c74object.description: An evieve version of the native mc.bands~ abstraction. In evieve the filters are updated to use TPT resonant filters, as well as some minor optimisations and utilities.

inlet.description: The number of filter bands to create.
The lowest filter band is set at this frequency in Hz.
The highest filter band is set at this frequency in Hz.
The bandwidth of all filter bands. 0% is very narrow, 100% is very wide.

outlet.description: The audio output, an X channel multichannel signal with X bands.

objarg.name: bands
objarg.description: The number of filter bands to create.

objarg.name: low
objarg.description: The lowest filter band is set at this frequency in Hz.

objarg.name: high
objarg.description: The highest filter band is set at this frequency in Hz.

objarg.name: bandwidth
objarg.description: The bandwidth of all filter bands. 0% is very narrow, 100% is very wide.

method.name: message
method.digest: In left inlet, the message 'bandwidth' followed by an int or float
method.description: In left inlet, the message 'bandwidth' followed by an int or float 0..100 sets the bandwidth of the filters in %.

attribute.name: compensate
attribute.description: Gain compensation flag to account for resonant filters at very high Q values.

attribute.name: maxbands
attribute.description: Maximum avilable bands (that the multichannelsignal can use)

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Smoothing time for the filter mixing gains.

attribute.name: tuning
attribute.description: Tuning for the Hz calculations of all filter bands.
